title: 一种解决英语动名词搭配错误的模型
description: Stable archival record for the 2016 Computer Science paper "一种解决英语动名词搭配错误的模型" / "Model to Solve English Verb-Noun Collocation Errors". The paper studies English verb-noun collocation error correction using collocation similarity, classification, and language-model ranking.
